EVMPatch is an automated patching approach for Ethereum smart contracts that works at the level of EVM bytecode. EVMPatch targets vulnerabilities in deployed contracts so that fixes can be applied in a timely manner. EVMPatch generates patches automatically rather than relying on manual code changes.

SODA is a generic online detection framework for smart contracts. SODA monitors contract execution at runtime rather than only analysing code before deployment. SODA is built from modular detectors that can be combined for different attack types.

SGUARD is an approach for automatically fixing vulnerable smart contracts. SGUARD addresses vulnerabilities by repairing the contract code rather than only reporting them.
